label: Agolic KLEE, GPT-5.5
description: An LLM agent (GPT-5.5, medium reasoning effort) plans a campaign of short KLEE runs and chooses for each run its target, command-line arguments, symbolic inputs, environment and concrete seeds from the source code and the coverage of earlier runs. Six execution slots for six hours.
reference: Koh, Noller, Pasareanu and Sun, "Agentic Planning for Symbolic Execution", arXiv 2608.06397, 2026
config: KLEE; reasoning effort medium; six slots; 60 turns per round

label: Agolic KLEE, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
description: The same agent and code with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at medium reasoning effort; the seed finder's web search goes through a search API instead of the model provider's hosted search. Nine programs, including seven reruns of runs that crashed.
reference: Koh, Noller, Pasareanu and Sun, "Agentic Planning for Symbolic Execution", arXiv 2608.06397, 2026
config: KLEE; reasoning effort medium; six slots; 60 turns per round

label: Agolic Direct-Input, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
description: The agent plans runs that execute whole concrete inputs (command-line arguments, standard input, files) natively, up to 32 inputs per run, and keeps every input as a test, with no symbolic execution and no solver. Nine programs.
reference: Koh, Noller, Pasareanu and Sun, "Agentic Planning for Symbolic Execution", arXiv 2608.06397, 2026
config: Direct-Input; reasoning effort medium; six slots; 60 turns per round

label: Agolic AFL++, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
description: The agent plans AFL++ runs and chooses run length, input channel, command-line arguments, seeds and whether to continue from earlier queues, on a CmpLog build with the seeds and dictionary of the original evaluation. Four programs.
reference: Koh, Noller, Pasareanu and Sun, "Agentic Planning for Symbolic Execution", arXiv 2608.06397, 2026
config: AFL++; reasoning effort medium; six slots; 60 turns per round

label: ConcoLLMic, GPT-5.5
description: ConcoLLMic, an agentic concolic executor, with GPT-5.5; a run stops after 30 minutes without new coverage or after six hours. Its retained test cases are replayed by the standard replay, and three of the seven programs have fewer than three completed runs.
config: --timeout 10 --plateau_slot 30 --parallel_num 5; reasoning effort medium

label: ConcoLLMic, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
description: ConcoLLMic with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash under the same stopping rule (30 minutes without new coverage, at most six hours). Three programs.
config: --timeout 10 --plateau_slot 30 --parallel_num 5; reasoning effort medium

label: KLEE fixed options, 6 cores
description: KLEE with its default search and fixed options, running under KLEE's symbolic-argument harness: the harness decides which arguments, files and standard input are symbolic and how large. Six workers run one six-hour invocation each and differ only in random seed.
reference: https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi-08/klee-unassisted-and-automatic-generation-high-coverage-tests-complex-systems
config: fixed options, default search; symbolic-argument harness; six workers

label: KLEE uniform options, 6 cores
description: KLEE running under KLEE's symbolic-argument harness, where each invocation samples its options uniformly from SymTuner's parameter space. Six workers, six hours.

config: options sampled uniformly from SymTuner's parameter space; symbolic-argument harness; six workers

label: SymTuner, 6 cores
description: SymTuner, an independent tool that tunes KLEE's options adaptively, ported to the study's KLEE build and running under KLEE's symbolic-argument harness. Six workers, six hours.
